stepProgress.description: Press the fingertip into contact preparation.
Press the mouse button to focus campaign objective.
Type the campaign objective with the keyboard.
Submit the campaign objective with the enter key.
Scroll the CRM segment panel to a structured view.
Press the mouse button to open the audience segment menu.
Type the audience segment with the keyboard.
Submit the audience segment with the enter key.
Press the mouse button to focus channel mix.
Type the channel mix to complete the strategy record.
Press the mouse button to focus slide title.
Type the slide title with the keyboard.
Submit the slide title with the enter key.
Press the mouse button to focus strategic message.
Type the strategic message with the keyboard.
Submit the strategic message with the enter key.
Press the mouse button to focus visual summary type.
Scroll the comments pane for stakeholder review.
Type the visual summary type with the keyboard.
Submit the visual summary type to complete the presentation.
